::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
IIT Hyderabad spin-off building reconfigurable processor architectures (REDEFINE). One of the earliest deep-tech semiconductor startups in India.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Coarse-grained reconfigurable array (CGRA) processors that can be dynamically reconfigured for different workloads — AI inference, signal processing, cryptography.
